SELECT e.emp_id AS user_id, e.emp_nm AS user_name, e.auth_st AS auth_status, e.ward_id, w.ward_nm AS ward_name FROM tb_emp e LEFT JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = e.ward_id AND w.hosp_div_id = e.hosp_div_id WHERE e.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalDomain} AND e.role_cd = 'USER' AND e.auth_st = 'APPROVED'
AND ( LOWER(e.emp_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(e.emp_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )
ORDER BY e.emp_nm, e.emp_id
SELECT ward_id, ward_nm AS ward_name FROM tb_ward WHERE hosp_div_id = #{hospitalDomain} ORDER BY ward_id
